metadata.compliance: 100% US/Western open-science sources (NASA NTRS, NASA-STD-3001, NASA BVAD, NASA OSDR, NASA RadLab, NASA EDA, NSSDCA). Zero Chinese-origin models or unverified sources.

physics_laws_never_violate: Mass and inertia NEVER decrease in low gravity or microgravity (F = m * a). Weight decreases (W = m * g), not mass or momentum.
Tsiolkovsky rocket equation: delta_v = Isp * g0 * ln(m0 / mf). Every kilogram added to the habitat exponentially increases propellant required.
In a 200 m3 habitat with 4 crew, CO2 toxic buildup (~11 hours to 0.5 kPa without scrubbing) kills MUCH faster than O2 depletion (~4 days to 16 kPa hypoxia) or starvation (weeks).

Thermal cascade: if radiators fail, habitat temperature rises -> at >30 C crops suffer damage -> at 32 C Tier 1 loads (crop LEDs + Sabatier) shed -> at 35 C Tier 2 loads (OGA electrolysis + WRS water recycler) shed -> total life-support collapse.

Hydrogen-rich materials (water tanks, polyethylene, food bags) shield against solar energetic protons (SPE) better than bare aluminum hulls because heavy metals produce secondary Bremsstrahlung/neutron radiation.
